portfolio_exit_engine.precedence_rule: ACTION_REQUIRED exit signals override static runtime HOLD ratings and must be reported before new GP deployment.
portfolio_exit_engine.thin_tape_rule: Thin or asynchronous tape changes the execution method and sizing; it does not by itself cancel a validated profit-taking signal.
portfolio_exit_engine.rule: Evaluate every non-use holding for after-tax profit capture before ranking new GP deployment. A recently realized configured catalyst plus strong patient and immediate profit, momentum and usable volume triggers staged basis recovery. Buyer flow controls execution risk and staging, but weak flow does not suppress an otherwise validated profit-taking signal. Extreme gains can trigger independently. Thin tape prohibits a market dump but never suppresses an otherwise validated patient sell.

profit_layer.allocation_rule: With unknown liquid cash, deploy incrementally down the marginal-capital ladder to modeled capacity. Fast flips require persistent-spread validation before allocation. Phase-2 fast flips use the price pair that maximizes modeled probability-weighted GP/hour; GE slots are ranked separately by GP per slot-hour. Phase-3 minimum absolute-profit hurdles remain observation-only until their promotion rule is satisfied.

ge_slot_optimizer.metric: probability-weighted GP per GE-slot-hour after modeled execution, tax, slippage and player-time adjustments
ge_slot_optimizer.rule: ACTIVE is reserved for short-cycle velocity, PARKING for patient evergreen/crash-catcher capital, and FLEXIBLE for relative-value or opportunistic use. Targets are soft architecture, not rigid caps; actual free-slot counts remain upper bounds until user-confirmed.

minimum_absolute_profit_hurdles.evaluation_basis: Probability-weighted expected profit at modeled capacity after tax, slippage, execution probability and any player-time shadow cost.

minimum_absolute_profit_hurdles.promotion_rule: Observe at least 12 relay cycles and 50 evaluated candidates. Promote only after review confirms the hurdles reduce low-value slot use without suppressing repeatable realized GP; changing rollout_status to ALLOCATION_AUTHORITATIVE is an explicit later decision.

repeatability_multiplier.rule: Repeatability is measured from persistent opportunity observations and user-confirmed executions. A multiplier above 1.0 also requires at least three profitable user-confirmed item round trips with a win rate of at least 50%; otherwise any book-only bonus is capped at 1.0. Multipliers remain advisory until the opportunity book and completed-round-trip thresholds clear and allocation authority is explicitly enabled.

persistent_opportunity_book.rule: Persistent observations are keyed by engine and opportunity. Repeated packet builds from the same RuneLite market snapshot are deduplicated; user-confirmed executions remain stronger evidence.

attention_modes.rule: Attention modes expose how candidate eligibility changes with player availability. NORMAL is the default scenario; modes do not alter live allocation until explicitly promoted.

remaining_upside_capital_rotation.rule: Issue a rotation alert only when a non-use holding has an explicit expected exit price and remaining payoff time, and another qualified opportunity materially dominates after tax, capacity and horizon scaling. Hold-for-use gear is always exempt.

realized_performance_dashboard.rule: Dashboard metrics use only user-confirmed round trips. Strategy ranking and realized GP-per-slot-hour remain non-authoritative until the minimum completed and timed sample thresholds clear.

real_execution_learning.rule: Real user-confirmed orders outrank shadow observations. Fill-time curves use only orders with known placement timestamps and only horizons with enough observation time; unknown timestamps never become negative samples.

spread_persistence.rule: Fast flips are not automatic-allocation eligible until a spread persists across at least three consecutive snapshots and the minimum time window with fresh HIGH/LOW prints, both sides trading, adequate volume and retained positive edge. REPEATABLE_MARKET requires a longer observation chain.

profit_layer.allocation_note: Exact GP allocation is intentionally not optimized when current liquid cash is unknown; the capital frontier ranks opportunities by expected GP velocity, capacity and execution quality.

records.summary: Breaker requires Ascension Shards plus a rune of some kind; the specific rune was not decided in the cited proposal.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Treat all rune-specific beneficiary calls as speculation until narrowed or confirmed.

records.summary: Prayer scroll supply weights were reduced while Ancestral relative weighting increased.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Fundamental supply changes are confirmed, but subsequent price direction must be read from live tape rather than assumed.

records.summary: All six proposed Fractured Archive rewards passed: Elemental Fragments 85.8%, Rondache 80.7%, Zorya's Tome 90.4%, Zeal 86.1%, Ascension Crossbows 85.6%, Breaker 88.4%. The Obligator won the Breaker visual poll.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Existence risk for the proposed reward set is sharply reduced. Legacy elemental and Crush beneficiaries gain catalyst credibility, but exact encounter utility is still unconfirmed. Breaker's specific charge rune remains unknown, so Wrath-specific conviction should not be upgraded on beneficiary selection alone.

records.summary: The Jeweller's Chisel now cuts bolt tips from gems in 2 ticks instead of 5 and has a 1-in-10 chance to cut 2 gems into bolt tips at once. A hotfix temporarily slows only the first gem in a multi-gem sequence; subsequent gems retain the improved 2-tick rate.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Legacy bolt-tip supply can now respond much faster to profitable conversion margins. This weakens any scarcity-based bull thesis for Diamond/Onyx bolt tips and makes tip-output price compression more likely during arbitrage, while potentially increasing demand for source gems when conversion economics are attractive.

records.summary: The Abyssal Lantern now functions outside Guardians of the Rift when burning logs with applicable effects. Jagex explicitly states rune-boosting effects such as Blisterwood apply to base runes crafted outside GOTR, not extra runes from Scar Essence extracts or Blood essence.
records.market_pricing_assessment: This creates an incremental production-efficiency increase for altar-crafted base runes and therefore slightly reduces the scarcity ceiling for any existing rune selected as Breaker's charge rune. The specific Breaker rune probability is unchanged; the development affects expected supply response, not beneficiary selection.

records.summary: Courier Tasks now award stackable Loot Sacks. Each sack has a 1-in-5 chance to contain a supply bundle; Cairn Isle thematic bundles explicitly include uncut gems up to diamonds, while Entrana bundles include various bones with higher-level bones from higher-tier sacks. Other ports add runes, scales, shards, ores, bars, planks and consumables.
records.market_pricing_assessment: This is a new repeatable commodity source. Diamond supply receives a direct incremental headwind through uncut-diamond drops. Broad bone supply also increases, but Jagex did not enumerate the exact higher-level bone types in this post, so a Dragon-bones-specific impact should remain unconfirmed until the drop table is established.

records.summary: The lock-in poll passed the proposed ability to trade grown dogs to an NPC for 100 Blood Runes, increasing to 200 with completion of the Morytania Medium Diary, by 78.7% Yes. The source depends on A Ruff Situation being implemented as described and is therefore a future supply catalyst rather than a current live source.
records.market_pricing_assessment: This adds a poll-confirmed future Blood-rune source and increases Blood-rune supply elasticity. It matters to the Breaker competing-rune basket because Blood would have somewhat more supply response if selected, but it provides no evidence that Jagex is more or less likely to choose Blood, Wrath, or another rune.

records.summary: Loot Sacks have now been removed from Bounty Task rewards and are only awarded for completing Courier Tasks.
records.market_pricing_assessment: The temporary unintended Bounty Task commodity source is now gone. This lowers Loot Sack commodity inflow versus the Aug 26-September 1 live state, partially offsetting but not reversing the permanent Courier Task supply increase for gems, bones and other commodities.

records.summary: Four elemental amulets are now live. Each consumes an Amulet of magic, a new Slayer-dropped elemental jewel and 100 matching elemental runes, gives +10 Magic Accuracy and +2 max hit to its matching elemental spells. Combining all four into the Elemental Amulet additionally consumes 500 of each elemental rune and provides the +2 max-hit effect to all elemental spells.
records.market_pricing_assessment: This converts the previously speculative Amulet-of-magic/elemental-rune demand thesis into an implemented recurring crafting sink. It also raises the practical value of standard elemental spells, especially hardware that efficiently casts or amplifies them, but does not by itself prove Raid 4 encounter demand or broad compatibility across every legacy staff.

records.summary: Ghommal's Lucky Penny can now be consumed to unlock its charge-saving effect without occupying the equipment slot, and that effect now applies to the Amulet of Blood Fury.
records.market_pricing_assessment: For players with Master-tier Combat Achievement completion, Blood Fury charges can now benefit from the Penny's saving effect without sacrificing the neck slot. That reduces marginal Blood shard replacement demand for this high-end cohort, a structural consumption headwind even though total Blood Fury usage could partially offset it.

records.summary: Jagex says it intends next week to make the elemental amulets' +2 max hit apply after Elemental Weakness and Magic Damage bonuses instead of being added to base damage before those multipliers. Jagex explicitly cited overly broad endgame strength, upcoming Fractured Archive Elemental Fragments, and the Harmonised-orb interaction as balance concerns.
records.market_pricing_assessment: This materially reduces the multiplicative endgame synergy that drove the strongest Harmonised/legacy elemental hardware thesis after the September 2 implementation. The amulets still consume Amulets of magic and elemental runes, so the direct crafting sink remains. Elemental Fragments remain a confirmed future Raid 4 reward, but the expected upside should be treated as more selective rather than a blanket multiplier-driven legacy gear rerating.

rule: Routine desk runs should use this lite packet only. Check portfolio_exit_engine before all new deployment analysis. If action_required=true, report the exit as a MATERIAL CHANGE with its exact staged execution plan; its dynamic rating overrides any static runtime HOLD label. Thin tape changes execution style and sizing, not the existence of a validated sell signal. Then use the marginal-capital ladder for incremental GP, the absolute-velocity frontier for total GP/hour, the GE-slot-hour frontier for scarce slot allocation, and the balanced frontier for final risk-adjusted ranking. Fast flips require spread persistence before allocation. Profit hurdles, repeatability, attention modes and capital rotation remain staged unless their allocation_authoritative field is true. Fetch the deep packet solely for missing fields or a user-requested deep dive. Speculative parks are advisory catalyst-backed parking ideas; cash remains valid and the speculative layer has no allocation authority unless explicitly promoted.

speculative_park.source: prices.runescape.wiki OSRS RuneLite data via market_universe + cached catalyst_state
speculative_park.objective: Rank long-horizon, catalyst-backed GP parking opportunities separately from fast flips and evergreen mean reversion. Cash remains the benchmark and speculative positions are never mandatory.

portfolio_policy.rule: Speculative parks require an explicit catalyst thesis, bounded sizing, patient entry, invalidation and acceptable RuneLite freshness/liquidity. They do not enter the normal capital frontier while allocation_authoritative=false.

speculative_park.execution_rule: PARK_NOW requires fresh, non-crossed RuneLite prints. Crossed/asynchronous current prints are watch-only; staleish candidates may remain patient deep bids but not market buys.
